decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch in the firm’s mechanical core, it is still within the period where a medium-sized established firm with some slack would tolerate uncertainty unless results clearly fall below aspiration.

This software-oriented water-facility system is newer and somewhat less clearly tied to the firm’s traditional machinery base, so it faces a higher risk of problemistic reallocation, but one year is still early for withdrawal.
Its own dedicated webpage signals stronger commitment and fit with the firm’s core water-regulation equipment, making it the least likely of the 2024 products to be dropped within the next year.
